name: Masked Clamp
description: Port of FFmpeg's maskedclamp filter: clamp the base clip between the dark and bright clips.

inputs.name: dark
inputs.description: Lower bound clip (same size as the base)

inputs.name: bright
inputs.description: Upper bound clip (same size as the base)

params.name: undershoot
params.description: How far below the dark clip the output may go, on the 0..255 (8-bit) scale

params.name: overshoot
params.description: How far above the bright clip the output may go, on the 0..255 scale

params.name: planes
params.description: Bit mask of the channels to filter (1 = R, 2 = G, 4 = B, 8 = A); the others are copied from the first input
